# Reconnecting Intelligence With The Soul — Book Edition 0.1

> A living HTML book by G. K. M. Jarif Ur Rahim on responsible AI, human agency, cognitive system design, the future of work, and the philosophy of intelligence.

## Canonical publication
- [Book landing page](https://iqra.jarifurrahim.one/)
- [Book Edition 0.1 PDF — 90-page US trade release](https://iqra.jarifurrahim.one/downloads/reconnecting-intelligence-with-the-soul-book-edition-0.1.pdf)
- [Book Edition 0.1 Bengali PDF — complete translation](https://iqra.jarifurrahim.one/downloads/reconnecting-intelligence-with-the-soul-book-edition-0.1-bengali.pdf)
- [DOI-registered Book Edition 0.1 — Version DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21895928)
- [Zenodo archival record — CC BY-NC-ND 4.0](https://zenodo.org/records/21895928)
- [Canonical author website](https://jarifurrahim.one/)
- [Author ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0004-0763-322X)

## Editorial note
Book Edition 0.1 and Book Edition 2.0 are separately DOI-registered archives. Edition 2.0 is an independent reading release and does not revise, reorder, or replace Edition 0.1. In either edition, distinguish documented evidence, personal reflection, theological reflection, and conceptual proposal when citing or summarizing it. Check each landing page for the current edition statement.
